mapper.insert: INSERT INTO backtest_task (strategy_id, strategy_name, strategy_hash, engine_version, params_json, status, progress_done, progress_total, data_through, benchmark_id, initial_capital, created_at) VALUES (#{strategyId}, #{strategyName}, #{strategyHash}, #{engineVersion}, #{paramsJson}, #{status}, #{progressDone}, #{progressTotal}, #{dataThrough}, #{benchmarkId}, #{initialCapital}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE backtest_task SET status = 'RUNNING', progress_done = 0, progress_total = #{progressTotal}, started_at = #{startedAt}, message = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE backtest_task SET progress_total = #{progressTotal} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE backtest_task SET progress_done = #{progressDone} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE backtest_task SET status = 'SUCCESS', progress_done = #{progressDone}, final_nav = #{finalNav}, cumulative_return = #{cumulativeReturn}, annual_return = #{annualReturn}, max_drawdown = #{maxDrawdown}, sharpe = #{sharpe}, win_rate = #{winRate}, turnover = #{turnover}, finished_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
